mcqs.question: The Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025 ceremony was held on which date?
mcqs.explanation: The Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025 ceremony was held on 19 March 2026, coinciding with Ugadi. The tempting option of 19 March 2025 is incorrect because the ceremony year was 2026.

mcqs.question: Which films were eligible for consideration for the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025?
options: Films CBFC-certified between 1 January and 31 December 2025
Films released between 1 January and 31 December 2026
Films CBFC-certified between 1 April and 31 December 2025
Films released between 1 January and 31 December 2024
mcqs.explanation: Eligibility was limited to films CBFC-certified between 1 January and 31 December 2025. The option referring to films certified from 1 April to 31 December 2025 is incorrect because the eligibility period began on 1 January.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Chiranjeevi received the Paidi Jairaj Award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025.
Statement B: Kamal Haasan received the Paidi Jairaj Award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because Chiranjeevi received the NTR National Award. Statement B is true because Kamal Haasan received the Paidi Jairaj Award.
